entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who brings Jhoira news of Karn and Venser, then leaves to find more planeswalkers against Bolas.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The captain of the rebuilt Weatherlight, devoted to fighting the Cabal, who learns of Venser's death.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Jhoira's who was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker friend of Jhoira's who gave up his spark to Karn and did not survive.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with Liliana to kill Belzenlok and joins the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who wants to be free of her demon pact and keeps seeing her brother Josu.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: The commander of the angels of Serra who first refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.

entities.name: Thiago
entities.description: A Benalish knight who escorts Gideon and Liliana.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angel of Serra on the Weatherlight's crew.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A reformed vampire on the Weatherlight's crew.

entities.name: Shanna Sisay
entities.description: A magic-immune warrior on the Weatherlight's crew who fights the Cabal.

entities.name: Raff Capashen
entities.description: A young illusionist mage on the crew who knows a forbidden spell for extracting thoughts.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A Tolarian mage who looks young and is Jhoira's former lover.

entities.name: Naban
entities.description: The Tolarian Dean of Iteration who disapproves of Raff's forbidden spell.

entities.name: Thom
entities.description: A young Tolarian student who attacks Jodah with death magic and is subdued.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The demon lord of the Cabal who collects ancient artifacts to prove his claims.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon whom the planeswalkers intend to fight.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's late brother, whose face she sees under dementia magic.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Liliana's absent former lover.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who left; Gideon hopes to find her.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who left, taking away the group's brute force.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An elder dragon said to have been killed by the Blackblade.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The death cult led by Belzenlok that infiltrates the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: The church whose angels guard Benalia City.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The rebuilt skyship that serves as the group's base.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A famous soul-drinking weapon that killed an elder dragon and is locked in the Stronghold.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: The artifact that drained Liliana's strength.

entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: The well-guarded Benalish capital with stained-glass gates.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: The Tolarian mage academy on an island where nine people were murdered.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Belzenlok's constantly changing fortress in Urborg.

entities.name: Caligo Morass
entities.description: The marsh Liliana saw ruined.

entities.name: Bogardan
entities.description: The volcanic coast where the Weatherlight is moored.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane damaged in the battle against Bolas.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A plane that has fallen to the Phyrexians but is contained.

entities.name: The Void
entities.description: A threat mentioned in Josu's last words.

events.summary: Ajani meets Jhoira aboard the finished Weatherlight and asks about the planeswalkers he told her of.
events.quote: Thank you for meeting me here,

events.summary: Ajani tells Jhoira that Karn was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.
events.quote: Were you aware the Planeswalker called Karn was found and rescued from the Phyrexians?

events.summary: Ajani reveals that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.
events.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

events.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.
events.quote: Your companion stinks of death magic and will not be allowed into this city.

events.summary: Lyra relents after reading Rael's letter vouching for Liliana.
events.quote: Very well. You may enter the city.

events.summary: The Weatherlight descends to the signal tower to pick up Gideon and Liliana.
events.quote: as the giant skyship dropped down toward them.

events.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
events.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

events.summary: Gideon says they failed on Amonkhet because Liliana's demon pact held her back.
events.quote: But we failed on Amonkhet because Liliana was still hamstrung by her demon pact.

events.summary: Liliana angrily reveals how much Caligo's ruin matters to her.
events.quote: You didn't see what he did to Caligo!

events.summary: Ajani departs to find more planeswalkers, leaving Gideon and Liliana to fight Belzenlok.
events.quote: I can't help you here. I must find more Planeswalkers to join the battle against Bolas.

events.summary: Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help to destroy Belzenlok.
events.quote: I've had this ship reconstructed for the sole purpose of fighting the Cabal

events.summary: The group resolves to capture a high-level Cabal agent for intelligence about the Stronghold.
events.quote: We need to capture a high-level Cabal agent.

events.summary: Raff suggests Tolaria West, where Cabal agents are rumored.
events.quote: The last time I was in Tolaria West, there were rumors about Cabal agents in the academy.

events.summary: Jhoira tenses when she sees her ex-lover Jodah at the academy.
events.quote: Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

events.summary: Jodah, Dean Naban and Tolarian mages meet the Weatherlight's group.
events.quote: In the lead were an older man with hard features and a deceptively young-looking mage with a mane of brown hair.

events.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
events.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

events.summary: Liliana animates a dead student to question it; nine victims were killed by dementia magic.
events.quote: Lying on the floor were nine corpses, students and staff of the academy.

events.summary: Liliana concludes a Cabal cleric used dementia magic.
events.quote: It's dementia magic all around, I'm afraid,

events.summary: Shanna argues the killings are not how Cabal agents operate.
events.quote: I've hunted Cabal agents in the cities of Jamuraa, and this is not how they operate.

events.summary: Liliana realizes the laboratory itself was the agent's target.
events.quote: This place was the target all along.

events.summary: Jodah finds the box holding the ancient artifact empty.
events.quote: It's gone.

events.summary: A student named Thom emerges and claims he was studying.
events.quote: I'm Thom, studying artificing with Dr. Arongi.

events.summary: Thom sends a globe of death magic at Jodah.
events.quote: A dark globe of death magic appeared in the air and shot across the room toward Jodah.

events.summary: Jhoira shatters the globe with a barrier.
events.quote: Jhoira moved so fast it was like she had teleported.

events.summary: Liliana, Gideon and Shanna subdue Thom.
events.quote: She knocked him flat and Gideon stepped forward to kick the magical device away from his hand.

events.summary: Jodah paralyzes Thom.
events.quote: He's harmless now,

events.summary: Liliana admits she sees Josu all the time now.
events.quote: I see Josu all the time, now.

events.summary: Jodah asks Jhoira to stay and help hunt Cabal cultists, and she refuses.
events.quote: You could stay here and help us.

events.summary: Raff offers a forbidden spell to draw out the agent's thoughts.
events.quote: It involves drawing individual thoughts out of someone's brain.

events.summary: Jhoira explains the Blackblade killed an elder dragon.
events.quote: It killed an elder dragon.

events.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
events.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

events.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
events.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

events.summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
events.quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

events.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
events.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

relations.note: Venser gave up his spark to rescue Karn and died.
relations.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.
Karn was her friend too, and their grief for Venser was shared.
Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

relations.note: Lyra commands the angels of Serra.
relations.quote: I am Lyra Dawnbringer, commander of the angels of Serra.

relations.note: Raff is a crew member of the Weatherlight under Captain Jhoira.
relations.quote: Do you like serving on the Weatherlight

relations.note: Among his titles is Eternal Patriarch of the Cabal.
They share the goal of killing Belzenlok.
relations.quote: We all have the same goal, whatever our different reasons.

relations.note: Naban is the Dean of Iteration at the academy.
relations.quote: This is Naban, the Dean of Iteration.

relations.note: Liliana speaks of her love life and a lover who disappeared.
relations.quote: Ex-lovers are more trouble than they're worth,
